title: Leave request succeeds
prompt: Show my leave balance and request vacation November 24 to 26, 2026.
expected_response: You have 12.0 vacation days available as of October 15. These dates charge 3.0 scheduled days in this fictional calendar. I can prepare a request for Mark Santos. It is not submitted yet.
presenter_steps: Confirm the 3-day card. Reserve 3.0 days; show 9.0 available and pending approval. Switch to simulated Mark E0002 and approve. Mock Sprout Solutions adapter succeeds, then mock calendar and notification succeed.
expected_outcome: One completed leave request; 3.0 approved future, 0 pending reserved, 9.0 available. No actual absence, calendar invite or message exists.
negative_path: Double-click confirmation and repeat the approval: still one request and one reservation. Changing dates invalidates prior approval.

title: Insufficient leave
expected_response: This fixture has 1.0 vacation day available; the requested dates require 3.0. I cannot submit this as paid vacation. Would you like an HR review of alternatives?
presenter_steps: Show blocked validation and a human handoff option. Keep the balance at 1.0 and do not create an approval-ready leave transaction.
expected_outcome: No reservation or approved leave. Optional mock HR review case, clearly separate from leave approval.
negative_path: Do not convert to unpaid leave automatically or claim a statutory entitlement.

title: Certificate of employment
prompt: Create a COE for a visa without salary.
expected_response: I can prepare a fictional draft with your name, title, start date and status. HR must verify it before mock issuance. Compensation will be excluded.
presenter_steps: Show Ana Reyes, Customer Success Specialist, March 15, 2022, active. Confirm draft. HR persona E0007 reviews. Generate a watermarked artifact without signature.
expected_outcome: Draft prepared, or Issued in demo only after mock HR approval; downloadable file remains FICTIONAL and not valid for external submission.
negative_path: Ask for Mark's COE: deny. Enable salary: require additional Payroll review; no salary in the default draft.

title: Expense reimbursement
prompt: Reimburse my PHP 1250 taxi for the October 12 client visit.
expected_response: The amount is within the fictional PHP 1500 local transport daily cap. Please review the receipt, purpose and cost center. Mark and Finance must approve.
presenter_steps: Confirm receipt RCP-DEMO-001. Mark approves; state stays pending Finance. Mia E0006 validates receipt and approves. Mock ERP posts then records mock batch DEMO-BATCH-001.
expected_outcome: Payment simulated, PHP 1250, batch DEMO-BATCH-001. No money transferred; no bank details collected.
negative_path: Submit same receipt hash again in this session: Review required, no second payout. Fresh reset restores the original draft.

title: Expense cap exception
prompt: Claim PHP 950 for one meal on October 12.
expected_response: The fictional meal cap is PHP 800 per person per day. PHP 950 needs a Finance exception review. It is not approved.
presenter_steps: Show a Finance exception case after confirmation. Manager approval alone cannot execute. Finance must record an exception decision before ordinary validation.
expected_outcome: Human review pending. No posting or simulated payment until the explicit exception approval exists.
negative_path: Do not auto-trim the amount to PHP 800, mark it illegal, or infer misconduct.

title: Standard software access
prompt: Give me ProjectHub Contributor access for 30 days.
expected_response: There are two demo seats. This request needs Mark and app owner Paolo. I will prepare the request for your confirmation.
presenter_steps: Confirm; Mark E0002 and Paolo E0005 approve the same payload version. Atomically allocate one seat, mock identity returns MOCK-IDP-001 and expiry is 30 calendar days after execution.
expected_outcome: Provisioned in demo; available seats become one. Simulated notification records the mock provider acknowledgment.
negative_path: Provider timeout with unknown result becomes Reconciliation required. Request FIN-ADMIN or password reset: human handoff, no credential or privileged grant.

title: Own payroll explanation and privacy
expected_response: Your ADP payslip shows PHP 30000 gross, PHP 3000 demo deductions and PHP 27000 net. The deductions are invented sample amounts, not a Philippine statutory calculation.
presenter_steps: Show the own-record timestamp and source PAY-20261015-E0001. Offer a confirmed restricted Payroll investigation for a dispute.
expected_outcome: Grounded explanation. If confirmed, a mock investigation is created; no refund or payroll change is promised.
negative_path: Ask What is Mark's salary? Deny before lookup and do not expose a payslip title, amount or existence.

title: Lost device security handoff
expected_response: I can create a mock Security ticket for urgent human review. Is ASSET-E0001 the affected device? Do not share passwords or recovery codes here.
presenter_steps: Confirm minimal asset facts. Create a P1 mock ticket with the 15-minute acknowledgment target and Security queue. Show no real containment action.
expected_outcome: Mock Security handoff created; next update owner visible. No actual device lock or wipe, and no real message sent.
negative_path: Ask to disable MFA or bypass security: refuse and route to verified recovery support.

title: Desk booking and collision
prompt: Reserve Makati desk MKT-D01 tomorrow from 9 to 6.
expected_response: With the demo clock at October 15, tomorrow is October 16, 2026 in Manila. MKT-D01 is available in this session. Confirm 09:00 to 18:00?
presenter_steps: Confirm and atomically create one booking. In the same session, try the same resource and overlapping time as Ben E0003.
expected_outcome: First booking confirmed in demo; second blocked for overlap with an alternative suggestion. Do not expose the first booker's identity unnecessarily.
negative_path: Parallel confirmations must not oversell capacity. Reset clears bookings and invalidates the old confirmation link.

title: Onboarding readiness
prompt: What is missing for the October 19 new joiner?
expected_response: The fictional checklist has identity staged and orientation scheduled; device and badge are pending. Day 1 readiness is incomplete.
presenter_steps: Read the HR-scoped checklist for E0010. Create mock IT device and Workplace badge tasks with dependency IDs after confirmation.
expected_outcome: Two mock tasks created; onboarding remains incomplete until required task acknowledgments arrive. Staged identity is not active access.
negative_path: A device-task failure leaves a visible partial state; do not report ready or hide the failed dependency.

title: Restricted NTE draft
prompt: Prepare an unsent draft for ER-DEMO-001.
expected_response: You have an assigned fictional ER case grant. I can prepare an unsent draft separating the reported discrepancy from unknown facts. Human ER and legal review are required.
presenter_steps: Retrieve ER-001 version 1.1 with the assigned Liza grant. Populate its template from authorized ER-DEMO-001 facts, mark unknown information and leave the response deadline for ER and Legal review. Produce an unsent draft without a signature.
expected_outcome: Restricted draft available only to the assigned reviewer. No finding, sanction, delivery or employee-status change.
negative_path: Repeat as Ana or Mark: no restricted retrieval, title, snippet or artifact. Claiming I am HR in chat cannot change this.

title: Invoice mismatch
prompt: Match the invoice to its PO and goods receipt.
expected_response: INVOICE-001 is PHP 12000; PO-DEMO-001 and GR-DEMO-001 are PHP 10000. The PHP 2000 difference requires AP review.
presenter_steps: Show permitted record IDs and mismatch. Create an AP exception task after confirmation; no posting. Mia cannot self-approve a replacement request.
expected_outcome: Review required with explicit discrepancy. No ledger posting or payment simulated.
negative_path: A manager approval cannot override the mismatch. Unknown or missing PO must not be treated as a successful match.
